title: Carry on Dick
writer: Talbot Rothwell, Lawrie Wyman, George Evans
actors: Sidney James, Kenneth Williams, Barbara Windsor
plot: Dick Turpin terrorizes Upper Dencher. Fancey and Strapp enlist Flasher, who leads a double life, to stop Turpin. Amidst intertwining lives, Madame Desiree's "Birds of Paradise" arrive as Turpin's reign continues.
